title: CLIMEDI
description: climedi.com.br CLIMEDI  private multidisciplinary medical clinic and diagnostic center in Aracaju, Sergipe, Brazil — founded 5 Oct 1977 by Dr. João Antônio Macedo Santana (endocrinologist & nuclear medicine physician, UFS professor, SUNY Upstate NY–trained). Family-run (Santana-Macedo dynasty: João, son Gustavo, daughter Sara), with 76–121 staff, 50+ physicians across 3 units. Its unique regional edge: full nuclear medicine — PET-CT, scintigraphy, and I-131 thyroid cancer therapy with 5 CNEN-compliant isolation suites — plus 20+ specialties (endocrinology, cardiology, gastro, mastology, orthopedics, ENT, neuro) and complete diagnostics (MRI, CT, mammography, endoscopy, bone densitometry, 54+ tests). Quality credentials: PNCQ "Excelente" (highest tier), SBAC, DICQ; registered in CNES, works with SUS, private insurers, and union health plans (APCEF+). Government payments total R$ 11M+ (Portal da Transparência); private revenue undisclosed (est. R$ 20–50M/yr).
